name: qualification-record
title: Qualification decision record
for_each: select id,name from contacts order by name

sections.title: Local score history
sections.note: Historical assessments. Re-score and use prioritise to check current eligibility.
sections.sql: select m.name model,s.fit,s.engagement,s.total,s.segment,s.blockers,s.as_of from score_runs s join models m on m.id=s.model_id where contact_id=$1 order by s.created_at desc

sections.title: Recorded activity
sections.sql: select kind,occurred_at,evidence,actor from events where contact_id=$1 order by occurred_at

sections.title: Imported vendor history
sections.note: Vendor and local numeric scales differ. These numbers are preserved, not treated as probabilities or equivalent scores.
sections.sql: select b.source,b.exported_at,v.fit_score,v.fit_segment,v.engagement_score,v.engagement_segment from vendor_scores v join import_batches b on b.id=v.batch_id where v.contact_id=$1 order by b.exported_at desc

sections.title: Operator notes
sections.sql: select body,actor,created_at from notes where contact_id=$1 order by created_at

name: model-review
title: Qualification policy review
for_each: select id,name from models order by name

sections.title: Version and weights
sections.sql: select name,active,policy,created_at from models where id=$1

sections.title: Recent decisions
sections.sql: select c.name,s.total,s.segment,s.as_of from score_runs s join contacts c on c.id=s.contact_id where s.model_id=$1 order by s.created_at desc limit 50

sections.title: Policy decisions
sections.sql: select action,actor,detail,created_at from audit_log where entity_id=$1 order by created_at
